+def _tokens(query: str):
+    """Split on unquoted whitespace, retaining which characters were quoted."""
+    value = []
+    unquoted = []
+    in_quotes = False
+    started = False
+    for char in query:
+        if char == '"':
+            in_quotes = not in_quotes
+            started = True
+        elif char.isspace() and not in_quotes:
+            if started:
+                yield "".join(value), unquoted
+                value, unquoted = [], []
+                started = False
+        else:
+            value.append(char)
+            unquoted.append(not in_quotes)
+            started = True
+    if in_quotes:
+        raise ShopError("unclosed quote")
+    if started:
+        yield "".join(value), unquoted
+
+
+def _parse_term(value: str, unquoted: list[bool]):
+    negated = bool(value and value[0] == "-" and unquoted[0])
+    if negated:
+        value, unquoted = value[1:], unquoted[1:]
+        if not value:
+            raise ShopError("empty negated term")
+
+    colon = next((i for i, char in enumerate(value) if char == ":" and unquoted[i]), -1)
+    if colon != -1:
+        field_name, field_value = value[:colon], value[colon + 1:]
+        if field_name not in ("sku", "name", "tag"):
+            raise ShopError("unknown search field")
+        if not field_value:
+            raise ShopError("empty field value")
+        match = _field_matcher(field_name, field_value)
+    else:
+        price = re.match(r"price(<=|>=|<|>|=)([\s\S]*)\Z", value)
+        if price and all(unquoted[: 5 + len(price.group(1))]):
+            amount = price.group(2)
+            if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", amount):
+                raise ShopError("invalid price")
+            compare = {"<": operator.lt, "<=": operator.le, ">": operator.gt,
+                       ">=": operator.ge, "=": operator.eq}[price.group(1)]
+            cents = int(amount)
+            match = lambda product: compare(product.price_cents, cents)
+        else:
+            match = _field_matcher("name", value)
+
+    if negated:
+        return lambda product: not match(product)
+    return match
+
+
+def _field_matcher(field_name: str, value: str):
+    value = value.casefold()
+    if field_name == "name":
+        return lambda product: value in product.name.casefold()
+
+    prefix = value.endswith("*")
+    if prefix:
+        value = value[:-1]
+
+    def matches(candidate: str) -> bool:
+        candidate = candidate.casefold()
+        return candidate.startswith(value) if prefix else candidate == value
+
+    if field_name == "sku":
+        return lambda product: matches(product.sku)
+    return lambda product: any(matches(tag) for tag in product.tags)
